open_points.subject: K-10 credential search in service answer bodies
open_points.text: K-10 says “The one search it makes in any answer body, a file's included, is for a credential echoed verbatim,” while A09 rules 5 and 7 say “reading stops at the ceiling” and only “[e]very body as read” is searched.
open_points.question: For a response body larger than service_response_bytes_max, must the kernel detect a verbatim credential occurring beyond the bytes it reads, or does “any answer body” mean only the prefix read up to the ceiling?
options: Search only the bytes read up to service_response_bytes_max; a credential occurring later is not detected.
Continue reading or draining the complete body solely to search for the credential, despite the response-size ceiling.
Refuse every oversized body without determining whether bytes beyond the ceiling contain the credential.
open_points.default_guess: Search only the bytes read up to service_response_bytes_max, following A09's explicit “body as read” rule.
